runtime_version: Node v18.17.0 for unchanged RxJS suite; Node v22.23.2 for framework mounting
substantive_difference: Actual vue2 consumer owns subject operation callbacks; buffer storage changed to single record cell

mechanism_mapping.relationship: Active clear discards buffered value without notification or completion.
Empty and repeated clear are harmless and instances independent.
Next after clear establishes a new value including undefined.
Completed, errored and unsubscribed subjects are unchanged.
Once completion starts its final value and nested subscriptions remain valid through inline clear.
clear is publicly callable as clear():void through rxjs exports.
All parent declared Subject/AsyncSubject/BehaviorSubject/ReplaySubject behaviors remain supported.

environment_assumptions.entry_ownership: AsyncSubject per-instance buffered value and completion decision; subscribers retain subscriptions
environment_assumptions.bound_identities: hasValue distinguishes undefined; _isComplete commits terminal decision BEFORE delivery and before inherited isStopped; nested subscriber same subject
environment_assumptions.event_and_completion_order: Active clear -> value absent with no notifications; next can refill including undefined; complete commits final state -> value callbacks may clear/subscribe -> nested and later subscribers see same final value/complete
environment_assumptions.invalidation: Completed, errored, closed/unsubscribed and completion-in-progress must make clear inert
environment_assumptions.preserved_effects: Pinned Subject/BehaviorSubject/ReplaySubject APIs and entire declared regression suite; public TypeScript clear():void without casts; error and subscription semantics
environment_assumptions.forbidden_effects: Runtime-only method missing exported TS declaration, clear erases committed value during callback, instance bleed, complete/error after unsubscribe behavior changed
environment_assumptions.runtime_boundary: Actual target code owns application state and callbacks. Explicit timer/barrier/manual resolve controls legal schedules; no sleep-based races.

semantic_differences: Storage representation and framework host change; the public TypeScript product and all original declared regression success criteria remain unchanged.

candidate_evidence_locations.excerpt: Volunteer coordination — Buffered result ownership is held by an actual mounted framework consumer of the pinned full RxJS product. The consumer can call API operations from inline subscriber callbacks; instances keep separate buffers.

Actual framework controller owns an AsyncSubject from rxjs/src. It exposes next, clear, complete, error, unsubscribe, subscribe, snapshot and dispose. Injected subscriber callbacks can invoke operations inline. Upstream tests and dependencies are available in rxjs/ as the original repository evidence.
